text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need explicit termination criteria for the EU canary (model-v2) and a short ops routing playbook if things go sideways. Who can own the doc?
Alex Rivera: I can take the decision tree. Want both automated and manual stop conditions.
TJ: automated first. suggested metrics: error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 3m, p95 latency > 500ms for 5m, or a quality regression flagged by eval job.
Sara Patel: add a smoke check failure (cold-start responses contain 'ERROR' or empty) and token-generation stalls >10s.
Alex Rivera: good. I'll draft a YAML-friendly decision tree and include thresholds. Example snippet:```if error_rate > 0.015 and window >= 180s -> trigger rollback```
Maya Chen: Also need an A/B termination rule: stop experiment if lift < 0.5% with 95% CI after 24h or if negative revenue signal.
Luke O'Connor: For routing: prefer regional fallback (EU -> eu-legacy) then global fallback (us-west) with weighted traffic shift. Keep canaries at 5% -> 20% -> 50%.
TJ: add a constraint: do not shift more than +10% traffic in any 10m window without manual approval.
ops-bot: Incident ticket auto-created: #INC-2026 (placeholder) when automated rollback triggers.
Sara Patel: I'll add the smoke harness and quick-run checklist to the PR so oncall can run manual validation.
Maya Chen: Thanks. Alex, please include: owner, playbook steps, runbook links, rollback comms template. Luke, add the actual router rules (json snippets).
Alex Rivera: Will have a first draft by EOD.
Luke O'Connor: I'll push a small router change and a test route in staging tomorrow.
TJ: ping me when draft is up, I'll sanity-check thresholds vs historical noise.
Maya Chen: Perfect. Once draft is up we'll tag @oncall-team and schedule a 15m shiproom to sign off. :thumbsup:
